messages:
nina.partnerships: Heads-up 1: onboarding runbook for AWS/GCP/Azure listing that includes optional hardware partner SKU (edge appliance). Need publisher IDs, manifest schema alignment, and a short customer-facing trial flow. Can we confirm who owns the GCP publisher and Azure tenant activation?

oliver.legal: @nina.partnerships I'll own the legal artifacts. Plan: adapt global T&C -> vendor-specific terms, add DPA link, and localize EN/DE/FR. For trials without CC, include abuse/chargeback clause. I'll upload drafts to the drive later today.

maya.product: SKU mapping suggestion:
- redwood-saas-standard (14d trial, metered)
- redwood-saas-enterprise (subscription, invoice)
- redwood-edge-box (hardware addon, one-time provisioning)
I recommend breaking out the edge SKU as a separate SKU with a bundle option in the manifest so partners can search independently.

chris.ops: Ops notes: AWS sandbox publisher id assigned: RBW-AWS-SB-2026. GCP publisher is pending (partner portal email sent). Azure publisher will land after tenant approval; I'm tracking. For automation, we need webhook endpoints for provisioning: `/marketplace/provision` and `/marketplace/webhook/entitlements`. Make sure these are reachable from vendor portals.

nina.partnerships: Marketing asks: hero image, 15s demo GIF, and 60-char headline. Prefer something like: "Predictable inference, simple marketplace onboarding". Design can we get a quick hero svg + GIF?

design-bot: Created a mock hero and GIF ticket: https://tasks.redwood/DR-210. Will share assets in #marketing in 24h.

oliver.legal: Quick policy note: Azure requires an explicit support SLA blurb for private plans. Also double-check tax/invoice language for EU customers.

maya.product: Manifest snippet (example) to include with PR:

```
{
  "offerId": "redwood-inference",
  "publisherId": "<vendor-publisher-id>",
  "skus": [
    {"id": "redwood-saas-standard", "pricing": "metered", "trialDays": 14},
    {"id": "redwood-saas-enterprise", "pricing": "subscription"},
    {"id": "redwood-edge-box", "pricing": "one_time"}
  ],
  "metadata": {"eu_data_only": false, "edge_compatible": true}
}
```

chris.ops: I'll run the AWS private-offer flow tonight and post the sandbox logs. If anyone needs access to the sandbox, request infra@redwood.com.

nina.partnerships: Action list: 1) @oliver.legal finalize localized T&Cs + DPA (due Thu 12:00 UTC). 2) @maya.product finalize SKU ids + example invoice lines (due Wed EOD). 3) @chris.ops complete AWS sandbox tests and provide webhook test (due Tue 23:59 UTC). 4) Design -> hero + GIF (due Fri). Follow-up sync Monday 9am PT in #partnerships.

design-bot: Uploaded placeholder hero: https://assets.redwood/marketplace/hero_placeholder.png

maya.product: Will open a PR with listing copy + quickstart curl example (ETA 6h).

nina.partnerships: Thanks team 1: if anything blocks publisher activation ping me directly.
